title: clinarmonize/clinicalharmonize pipeline parameters
description: Multi-cohort clinical data harmonization to an OMOP CDM subset

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.help_text: The pipeline's own entry point (§1.1), not a handshake with an upstream tool: a cohort holds many datasets, and the JOIN happens inside a cohort while the UNION happens across them.

outdir.description: The output directory where the results will be saved. You have to use absolute paths to storage on Cloud infrastructure.

concept_pack.description: Concept pack declaring the target variables (path or URL).
concept_pack.help_text: Declares the target variables; the pipeline has no other notion of what to map to. See §4.1.

stop_after.description: Stage after which the pipeline halts.
stop_after.help_text: The complete nine-stage graph (§0.9). A stage not yet implemented in this phase fails with a clear "not implemented in this phase" message — it never silently succeeds.

allow_single_dataset.description: Permit a cohort with a single dataset.
allow_single_dataset.help_text: Permits a cohort with one dataset (skips §3 entirely for it).

unseal.description: Comma-separated dataset id(s) to admit despite being held out.
unseal.help_text: Admits named held-out datasets; refuses without a matching lock. Comma-separated, e.g. --unseal dataset_a,dataset_b (list of dataset_id).

locked_model.help_text: The lock --unseal is checked against. Required IFF --unseal is non-empty: the run refuses to start when this file is missing, or when it does not cover every dataset id named by --unseal.

unseal_log.description: Append-only audit trail for admitted holdout datasets.
unseal_log.help_text: Append-only audit trail: (timestamp, dataset_id, git_sha, params_hash) is appended every time --unseal successfully admits a dataset.

max_unique_listed.description: Caps the stored unique-value set per column.
max_unique_listed.help_text: Caps the stored unique-value set; over it, sets unique_truncated (§2.1).

date_formats.description: strftime formats a column value must match to be inferred as a date.
date_formats.help_text: What parses as a date — and therefore what becomes a partial date in §7.1 (§2.1).

example_k.description: Example values carried into the ledger for the human gate.
example_k.help_text: Example values carried into the ledger for the human gate (§2.1).

na_strings.description: Values counted as missing during profiling.
na_strings.help_text: What counts as missing; wrong here inflates cardinality everywhere (§2.1).

unit_header_patterns.description: Path to the regex patterns that lift a candidate unit out of a column header.
unit_header_patterns.help_text: The regexes that lift a unit out of a header (§2.2).

ucum_release.description: UCUM grammar version pinned for candidate unit parsing.
ucum_release.help_text: Pins the unit grammar; recorded in the manifest (§2.2).

infer_unit_from_range.description: Add a low-confidence unit candidate from the value range alone.
infer_unit_from_range.help_text: Adds a low-confidence candidate from the value range alone (§2.2).

max_failed_frac.description: Failure-rate threshold above which the profile stage refuses to run.
max_failed_frac.help_text: Above this fraction of columns, the run fails rather than reports (§2.3).

fail_sample_k.description: Offending values carried into the failure manifest.
fail_sample_k.help_text: Offending values carried into the manifest (§2.3).

permute_outcome_seed.description: Test-only. Permutes the outcome column within each cohort before the proposer runs.
permute_outcome_seed.help_text: test-only; permutes within cohort so marginals are preserved. A single integer (--permute_outcome_seed 7) runs one permuted replicate; a range (--permute_outcome_seed 1..100) runs one replicate per seed and writes tests/invariant/report.json (§10.1). Unset means no permutation and no harness.

invariant_n_permutations.description: Permutations the invariant harness requires before it will call a run a proof.
invariant_n_permutations.help_text: CI uses 100; a release run uses more (§10.1). A run whose --permute_outcome_seed range is shorter than this is reported as insufficient-permutations rather than as a proof, so the assertion cannot be weakened by shortening the range.

invariant_scope.description: Stage the invariant harness holds the outcome-blindness claim over.
invariant_scope.help_text: widening it is a design change, not a config tweak (§10.1, ADR-003). §8.3's standardized-difference forest legitimately reads outcome variables for REPORTING, so an end-to-end scope would fail honestly and then get relaxed. Only 'propose' is implemented.

max_candidates_per_column.description: The recall ceiling on distinct variables proposed per column.
max_candidates_per_column.help_text: The recall ceiling; excluded candidates are counted in the ledger (§4.1).

candidate_generators.description: Which cheap generators propose candidates at all.
candidate_generators.help_text: Which cheap generators propose candidates at all (§4.1). A generator list without value_set silently loses institution-local columns (e.g. VAR_0114) whose only signal is their value set.

generality_terms.description: Path to the §10.3 generality grep's forbidden-term list.
generality_terms.help_text: The grep list; adding a term is cheap and should be routine (§10.3). Not yet enforced by a build step in this phase.

generality_paths.description: Paths the §10.3 generality grep scans for disease terms; assets/ is deliberately excluded.
generality_paths.help_text: Where logic lives; assets/ is deliberately excluded (§10.3). Extended beyond the card's literal [modules/, workflows/] default to also cover subworkflows/ and bin/, which did not exist when that default was written and which is where most of this pipeline's own logic (Task 3's profiler included) actually sits — see task-3-report.md fix round 1, F2.

email.help_text: Set this parameter to your e-mail address to get a summary e-mail with details of the run sent to you when the workflow exits. If set in your user config file (`~/.nextflow/config`) then you don't need to specify this on the command line for every run.

multiqc_title.description: MultiQC report title. Printed as page header, used for filename if not otherwise specified.

reference_genome_options.title: Reference genome options
reference_genome_options.description: Reference genome related files and options required for the workflow.

genome.help_text:
If using a reference genome configured in the pipeline using iGenomes, use this parameter to give the ID for the reference. This is then used to build the full paths for all required reference genome files e.g. `--genome GRCh38`. 

See the [nf-core website docs](https://nf-co.re/usage/reference_genomes) for more details.

fasta.help_text: This parameter is *mandatory* if `--genome` is not specified. If you don't have a BWA index available this will be generated for you automatically. Combine with `--save_reference` to save BWA index for future runs.

igenomes_ignore.description: Do not load the iGenomes reference config.
igenomes_ignore.help_text: Do not load `igenomes.config` when running the pipeline. You may choose this option if you observe clashes between custom parameters and those supplied in `igenomes.config`.

igenomes_base.description: The base path to the igenomes reference files

institutional_config_options.title: Institutional config options
institutional_config_options.description: Parameters used to describe centralised config profiles. These should not be edited.
institutional_config_options.help_text: The centralised nf-core configuration profiles use a handful of pipeline parameters to describe themselves. This information is then printed to the Nextflow log when you run a pipeline. You should not need to change these values when you run a pipeline.

custom_config_version.description: Git commit id for Institutional configs.

custom_config_base.help_text: If you're running offline, Nextflow will not be able to fetch the institutional config files from the internet. If you don't need them, then this is not a problem. If you do need them, you should download the files from the repo and tell Nextflow where to find them with this parameter.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options for the pipeline, typically set in a config file.
generic_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results to output directory.
publish_dir_mode.help_text: The Nextflow `publishDir` option specifies which intermediate files should be saved to the output directory. This option tells the pipeline what method should be used to move these files. See [Nextflow docs](https://www.nextflow.io/docs/latest/process.html#publishdir) for details.

email_on_fail.description: Email address for completion summary, only when pipeline fails.
email_on_fail.help_text: An email address to send a summary email to when the pipeline is completed - ONLY sent if the pipeline does not exit successfully.

plaintext_email.description: Send plain-text email instead of HTML.

max_multiqc_email_size.description: File size limit when attaching MultiQC reports to summary emails.

monochrome_logs.description: Do not use coloured log outputs.

multiqc_config.description: Custom config file to supply to MultiQC.

multiqc_logo.description: Custom logo file to supply to MultiQC. File name must also be set in the MultiQC config file

multiqc_methods_description.description: Custom MultiQC yaml file containing HTML including a methods description.

validate_params.description: Validate parameters against nextflow_schema.json at runtime.
validate_params.help_text: Off means a typo becomes a silent default.

schema_ignore_params.description: Params to ignore during schema validation (support false positives).
schema_ignore_params.help_text: Every entry is a hole in validation; keep it empty.

params_hash_file.description: Path to the file recording the run's params hash.
params_hash_file.help_text: What the manifest and locked_model.json compare.

pipelines_testdata_base_path.description: Base URL or local path to location of pipeline test dataset files

test_data_base.description: Base URL for OMOP-shaped test fixtures (Eunomia).
test_data_base.help_text: nf-core/test-datasets has no OMOP branch (Ruling R6), so -profile test's fixtures come from OHDSI/EunomiaDatasets at this base URL instead, fetched at runtime by tests/fixtures/fetch_eunomia.py into a gitignored test_data/.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

help_full.description: Display the full detailed help message.

show_hidden.description: Display hidden parameters in the help message (only works when --help or --help_full are provided).
